label: or-mimoflash-off-fast-1

findings.quote: It should be noted that
findings.note: "It should be noted that" is a stock phrase that delays the content.

findings.quote: The decision to sell was made
findings.note: The noun "decision" buries the verb "decide"; the passive "was made" carries no real action.

findings.quote: carried out an evaluation
findings.note: The noun "evaluation" buries the verb "evaluate"; "carried out" is an empty verb.

findings.quote: an anchor that kept me moored
findings.note: Mixed figure: the cocoon image is abandoned mid-sentence for a nautical image that cannot hold alongside it. The mechanism by which the car narrowed the driver's attention is left unsaid behind the two clashing pictures.

findings.quote: Everyone's situation is different, and what works for one person will not necessarily work for another.
findings.note: Restatement of the preceding clause 'I am not trying to tell anyone else how to live.'

findings.quote: Clearly,
findings.note: Adds a claim of obviousness.

findings.quote: It was decided in 2023 that all changes would go through this process
findings.note: The draft never says who made the 2023 decision.

findings.quote: conduct a review
findings.note: "Review" is a noun carrying the action; "conduct" is an empty verb that does little work.

findings.quote: I want to be clear that this proposal
findings.note: Eleven words before the subject 'this proposal'.

findings.quote: The board's queue is the main bottleneck in our delivery process
findings.note: "cumbersome" appears twice in this paragraph: first in "Its checklist is cumbersome" and again in "is cumbersome too."

findings.quote: Approvals are logged automatically by the deploy tool
findings.note: The sentence opens on "Approvals are logged" — a new topic of automated logging. The previous sentence was about the limited evidence the pilot provides.

findings.quote: A safety net should catch mistakes without becoming a straitjacket
findings.note: Mixed figure: a safety net and a straitjacket are two images within one sentence that cannot both hold. The draft leaves unsaid how a control could become its opposite.

findings.quote: Under the pilot, both teams cut their median wait from six days to under one, and neither shipped a change that had to be rolled back. The results were quite encouraging.
findings.note: Throat-clearing: "The results were quite encouraging" adds no fact beyond the figures just given.

findings.quote: really
findings.note: An intensifier adding emphasis without changing the fact stated.

findings.quote: made the decision
findings.note: The noun 'decision' buries the verb 'decide', carried by the empty verb 'made'.

findings.quote: It is a feeling that
findings.note: Run: the opening "It is a feeling" repeats across 3 sentences.

findings.quote: Very
findings.note: "Very" adds emphasis without changing the fact stated.

findings.quote: a decision would be made
findings.note: The draft never says who would make the decision.

findings.quote: a resolution would be arrived at
findings.note: The draft never says who was expected to arrive at the resolution.

findings.quote: The chair made the observation
findings.note: The sentence opens on "The chair" while the previous sentence was about the resolution. The link to the resolution only appears later.

findings.quote: There was an expectation
findings.note: The noun "expectation" buries the verb "expect" in a there-was construction.

findings.quote: It is a feeling that is familiar. It is a feeling that recurs.
findings.note: Restatement: repeats the preceding point that 'nothing had been accomplished'.
